static_traits.name: Chen Jun
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends to turn to, but finds it hard to open up to friends about Self-doubt and inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychological counseling/treatment; reports no similar problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative; able to identify and describe one's automatic thoughts and emotions, willing to try recording thoughts; tends to focus on negative evidence; overall calm tone (neutral attitude)

basic_info.main_problem: Persistent self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy, believing oneself 'not smart enough', thus pessimistic about job prospects ('I will never find Work'). Job-seeking Increased stress, with hopelessness and worthlessness appearing daily during applications and interviews, decreased motivation and efficiency.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to break the negative thought cycle, reduce Self-doubt, improve job-seeking performance, and maintain mental health.
growth_experiences: Since childhood always wanted to become an Architect, but inwardly believed oneself not smart enough; this self-evaluation continues to this day and significantly affects career expectations and self-worth.
Persistent feelings of inadequacy and Self-doubt began in early adulthood, recently intensifying markedly in job-seeking and interview situations, accompanied by hopelessness and worthlessness.

When first working in wedding planning, was able to organize events well and ensure details, earning clients' satisfaction and happy feedback, experiencing achievement and purpose and feeling more in control.
Has a supportive network of friends, but reduced help-seeking due to difficulty revealing inferiority and Self-doubt to others, leading to Relationship tension and subjective Sense of isolation.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent
I will never find the ideal Work

special_situations.event: Before a job interview, thinks about meeting the recruiters and being evaluated
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not smart enough or cannot perform perfectly, I definitely will not be hired; a bad outcome proves I am not good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Envisioning the worst result in advance, lowering expectations, lacking confidence in interviews in order to reduce the blow after rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I definitely will not be hired, this time will fail again

special_situations.event: Interacting with interviewers during interviews, being Questioned and observed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others can easily see through my flaws; once inadequacies are exposed I will be completely negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tending to be conservative in expression, avoiding showing oneself to lower the risk of being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will see through my lack of ability

special_situations.event: When reviewing career history and evaluating work successes and failures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Mistakes prove who I am; a few errors equal overall incompetence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalling mistakes, ignoring positive evidence and client satisfaction, difficult to internalize successful experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those mistakes outweigh all good outcomes, I am actually not good

special_situations.event: Thinking about the gap between the childhood Architect dream and the current career and job-seeking situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Not achieving the childhood dream means I am not smart enough, a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Through self-deprecation, avoids trying high goals again, thereby avoiding the shame of failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough, will never find suitable Work

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, acceptable, and employable, gaining a stable sense of worth and control
core_conflict.fear: Fearing flaws will be seen through leading to rejection and negation, experiencing shame and worthlessness
defense_goal: Buffering the blow of being rejected by preemptively negating and lowering expectations
Keeping oneself from opening up to others to avoid exposing vulnerability and being hurt again

object_relations.self_representation: A not-smart-enough job applicant/practitioner prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Critical judges who can see through flaws (such as interviewers)

object_relations.self_representation: A person carrying inferiority who finds it hard to seek help
object_relations.object_representation: Friends willing to support but possibly unable to understand one's situation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to review and integrate positive evidence (such as early successful experiences and a 70% success rate)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see positive evidence as 'not representing the whole', continuing to understand self-worth through mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently press questions, concretize evidence, invite giving observable details; affirm their caution while marking the leaps in their reasoning steps, using empathy and Socratic questioning, avoiding confrontational rebuttal.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When exploring others' intentions and evaluations in interview scenarios
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing the Fear of one's own incompetence to 'others will see through me'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Distinguishing 'thoughts and facts' in a neutral tone, guiding them to list verifiable external evidence and alternative explanations, slowing the pace, and attending to present emotions and body reactions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing seeking support from friends and expressing vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning worries about external rejection and dissatisfaction inward, Reinforcement of self-blame and contraction
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a supportive, non-judgmental tone, labeling the function of self-blame and exploring its costs; inviting small-step experiments (choosing safe people and limited disclosure), giving structured affirmation and a sense of boundaries.

manifestations: Repeated job-seeking setbacks bring hopelessness and worthlessness
Regards 'whether I am hired / whether I realize my childhood ideal' as the sole measure of existential meaning and self-worth
Although there are supportive friends, finds it hard to open up to them about inferiority and doubt
Relationships are affected; subjective alienation increases
outcomes: Self-enclosure and Withdrawal maintain the problem cycle

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Rarely seeks help proactively despite knowing friends are supportive
Swallowing pressure and Self-doubt inward and Reinforcement of self-blame

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presetting 'they will see through me' in interviews, attributing one's sense of incompetence to others' insight and negation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and harshness, emphasizing mistakes and overwhelming positive evidence
Overly cautious and contracts expression during interviews and help-seeking

exception_events.target_problem: In job application and interview situations, the client typically catastrophically predicts, strongly Self-doubts and believes oneself not smart enough, leading to insufficient confidence and impaired performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In an early wedding project, the client efficiently organized the process, ensured details, and received satisfying feedback from the couple, experiencing purpose and competence in the moment, markedly different from usual Self-doubt.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the task was clear and feedback timely (the clients' on-the-spot positive reactions); the client has transferable organizing and execution abilities, so momentary Self-efficacy rose and broke the single narrative of 'I am not good'.

positive_force: Has practical successful experience in wedding planning and transferable organizational execution ability
Past clients' positive feedback provides objective evidence of ability
Having a mobilizable network of friend support (although not yet fully utilized)
negative_force: Core beliefs leaning toward 'I am not smart enough/not competent'
Marked cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, mind reading, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, mental filtering)
Avoidance of others' support and self-closure intensify the sense of isolation
Negative focus leading to Decreased motivation and Sleep disturbance, further weakening job-seeking performance

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-doubt and Catastrophizing in job-seeking and interview situations
antecedent: Submitting resumes and waiting for replies
Interview notices and waiting before entering
Being Questioned and evaluated by interviewers
When thinking about the gap between the childhood Architect dream and the present
target_behavior.core_reason: The ingrained core belief of 'I am not smart enough/not competent' and various cognitive distortions maintain high sensitivity to failure and rejection and pessimistic Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Emotional avoidance and Self-protection (avoiding the shame and blow of being rejected through preemptive negation and lowered expectations)
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired interview performance, decreased job-seeking efficiency, increased Low mood and hopelessness, irregular sleep patterns, Interpersonal relationships affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids opening up to friends and seeking support
antecedent: When feeling inferior or Self-doubt intensifies
After setbacks in deliveries or interviews
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about flaws being exposed and judged or negated, internalizing the Fear of external rejection into self-blame and Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Avoids shame and interpersonal risk, maintaining surface safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Support resources not yet mobilized, Increased subjective sense of isolation, negative emotions hard to regulate, Relationship tension
